parameters.help_en:
The language type for receiving messages. Valid values:
zh: (default) Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：（默认）中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The task type. For valid values, refer to the API operation that queries file download task types
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，枚举值。可填枚举值见接口：查询文件下载任务类型
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The query conditions for the download task. This parameter is required. If it is not provided, the API returns error code -340408 (download task TaskData invalid)
parameters.help_zh: 下载任务的请求查询条件。本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回错误码 -340408（download task TaskData invalid），不可省略
parameters.name: task_data

parameters.help_en: The time zone for time information in the downloaded file, using an IANA time zone identity. Default value: Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 下载文件中时间信息的时区，使用IANA时区标识符。默认为北京时间，即Asia/Shanghai
parameters.name: time_zone

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
finish: The task is completed. You can query the task to obtain the download URL of the task file.
start: The task is started.
error: The task failed.
expire: The task has expired. The task file is invalid and cannot be downloaded.
Note: This field is returned only under specific conditions, such as when the task is synchronously completed. A regular response returns only RequestId. Use a task query API operation to query the real-time status
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

finish：任务完成。即任务已经完成，可以通过查询任务，获取任务文件下载链接。

start：任务开始。

error：任务失败。

expire：任务过期。即任务文件已经失效，无法下载。

注意：本字段仅在任务同步完成等特定条件下返回，常规响应仅返回 RequestId；请通过任务查询类接口查询实时状态

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which is the unique identifier of the task. Note: This field is returned only under specific conditions, such as when the task is synchronously completed. A regular response returns only RequestId. Use a task query API operation to obtain the task status and download URL
TaskId.description_zh: 任务Id，任务的唯一标识。注意：本字段仅在任务同步完成等特定条件下返回，常规响应仅返回 RequestId；请通过任务查询类接口获取任务状态与下载链接

TaskName.description_en: The name of the file download task. Note: This field is returned only under specific conditions, such as when the task is synchronously completed. A regular response returns only RequestId
TaskName.description_zh: 文件下载任务的名称。注意：本字段仅在任务同步完成等特定条件下返回，常规响应仅返回 RequestId
